summary: Iter 13 full backend + frontend verification of new SaaS subscription billing system. 13/13 new billing pytests pass (plans catalog, half_year+annual create, auto-supersede, cancel + 400-on-already-cancelled, list with tenant+plan_label join, revenue KPIs + 30d trend, tenant billing history, 403 for tenant-admin, 400 on unknown plan, tenant doc reflects plan/status/end_date/current_subscription_id). 30/30 regression tests pass (iter7=17 + iter10=3 + iter11=10). Frontend: super-admin → Billing & Subscriptions tab renders billing-panel with 4 KPI cards (rev-today/month/all-time/active-count), 30-day Recharts LineChart, subscription table with status pills + payment-ref column, New Subscription modal opens, plan toggle (half_year ₹10,000 / annual ₹20,000) updates summary card, submit creates row + KPIs reactively update (₹50k → ₹60k → ₹70k across the test runs), cancel button (cancel-sub-{id}) triggers window.confirm + API call and row flips to grey CANCELLED. Emergent badge is fully hidden (iframe[src*='emergent'] not present in DOM on super-admin).
critical_code_review_comments: Subscription billing endpoints are correctly placed BEFORE GET /super-admin/tenants/{tid} so the /tenants/{tid}/billing route is not shadowed by the generic tenant lookup — verified by passing tests.
Auto-supersede uses update_many on status='active' — correctly enforces single-active-sub invariant per tenant.
Cancel on already-cancelled returns 400 (good). Cancel also flips tenant.status to 'cancelled' which mirrors soft-delete flow.

Revenue 30d trend is computed in Python from db.subscription_payments.find({}).to_list(2000) — at scale (>2000 payments) this will silently truncate. Recommend a $gte: today-30d Mongo filter or aggregation pipeline once volume grows, but fine for current MVP.
PLAN_CATALOG is a module-level dict — fine for now, but ideally would live in a Mongo collection so super-admins could add plans without code changes (future iter).

Pre-existing hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' originates from Emergent dev-tracker injecting tracking spans into <option> elements of the tenant select. Already noted in iter12; not iter13-introduced. Non-blocking.

Run pytest with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported and addopts cleared because pytest.ini enables xdist by default and the iter13 file uses pytest.<attr> module-level state which loadscope still supports BUT clearer to run with -o 'addopts='. Active sub for miracurl-marathahalli is TEST_UI_POSTCANCEL_RESTORE; today's revenue baseline is ~₹70k from iter13 testing — future iterations should account for or clean up these TEST_ subs if revenue math matters.
